name: Encrypted Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, a coded summons calls new night elf rogues to begin their training. Conservator Ilthalaine carries it for Frahun Shadewhisper, who also warns of the fragile peace across Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Message in the Shadows
sections.body: While young night elves study nature's balance under Conservator Ilthalaine, those drawn to stealth receive a quieter summons. A runner brings the Encrypted Sigil from Frahun Shadewhisper, Shadowglen's rogue mentor. Its ciphers are meant for initiates of the trade. The bearer is to decipher the message and find Frahun near the roots of Aldrassil to begin instruction.

sections.title: Watching the Horizon
sections.body: Frahun's message also warns of Kalimdor's uncertain peace. The Third War has ended, but the truce between the Alliance and the emerging Horde remains fragile. Rogue scouts and informers in Shadowglen are urged to sharpen their eyes and ears early. They watch for threats and covert provocations that could renew war across the borders.

faq.answer: The Encrypted Sigil is a coded token from rogue mentor Frahun Shadewhisper, directing new rogues in Shadowglen to find him beneath Aldrassil for training.

faq.q: Who hands the sigil to young night elves?
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine delivers the sigil on Frahun's behalf once an initiate has shown basic skill in managing the local wildlife around Shadowglen's boughs.

faq.q: Where can Frahun Shadewhisper be found?
faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper can be found within the shelter of the Great Tree Aldrassil in Shadowglen, ready to instruct newly arrived night elf rogues.

faq.q: Why are rogues needed in peaceful Teldrassil?
aliases: why do night elves need rogues
faq.answer: Rogues are needed because the truce with outside factions is fragile. Scouts and informers watch for subterfuge, including Horde movements and threats within the boughs.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil to Frahun?
faq.answer: After you present the sigil, Frahun accepts the cipher and acknowledges your readiness. He invites you to return as you gain experience, so he can teach combat techniques, weapon handling, and stealth.

faq.q: Does the Horde actively threaten Shadowglen directly?
faq.answer: The Horde does not openly assault secluded Teldrassil, but whispers that Horde agents are sowing distrust across Kalimdor keep kaldorei sentries and operatives alert.

angles.text: As a rogue, you enter the kaldorei network of scouts, assassins, and informers who protect Teldrassil from unseen adversaries.
As a night elf, you share Aldrassil's watch over Kalimdor's shifting borders and defend the newly planted boughs.
As an Alliance member, you hear Shadowglen's trainers warn that treaties between factions are fragile and intelligence work helps prevent Horde incursions.
